works.title: Project 2030
works.description: A strategic counter-document to Project 2025 that maps authoritarian methodologies but applies them toward progressive and democratic ends. Describes concrete policy approaches to dismantle Trump's agenda and establish its institutional opposite.
works.quote: This underscores my need to produce a counter document, Project 2030, that describes how to use the same methods to dismantle what Trump is trying to accomplish and instead install the exact opposite regime.
